rows.题材标签: 真人风、舞蹈、运镜
rows.判断理由: 原地卡点摆胯舞（镂空连体衣+短裤），对应作者783赞视频；无裸露
rows.步骤1提示词:
A single uncut in-place beat dance by a beautiful adult woman with very long dark wavy hair tied with a small light-blue ribbon, wearing a grey ribbed-knit sleeveless mock-neck bodysuit with waist side cutouts and a tiny diamond cutout at the abdomen, light-blue drawstring shorts with white trim and a white bow, and a white thigh band on one leg. She dances against a plain cream wall crossed by strong diagonal window-blind light stripes, warm high-key daylight, her striped shadow thrown on the wall beside her. The track runs at about 129 BPM in 4/4 — one beat every 0.46 seconds, bar lines at roughly 0.2, 2.0, 3.9, 5.7 and 7.6 seconds — and every accent action lands on a beat: she opens in a back three-quarter pose glancing over her shoulder, turns to the front as her hips start moving, raises both hands behind her head and holds that pose while her hips keep swaying, releases her arms and opens them wide, reaches forward as she turns away, and finishes in a back three-quarter stance with slow heavy hip sways and small downward hand flicks behind her, the clip cutting mid-sway.
Camera: locked tripod, camera not moving for the whole clip; framing from the top of her head (about 3 percent from the top edge) to mid-thigh, feet never in frame; the wall stripes and her shadow stay fixed in the frame — every change of angle comes from her own turns, never from the camera.
Magnitude anchors: the hip sways are big and heavy — on each accent her hips travel wider than her shoulder line, her long hair swings across her back and brushes her arms, and her striped shadow sweeps left and right across the wall with her. During the hands-behind-head hold the hips must keep crossing her center line on every beat; if the sways come out small, soft or polite, the take is wrong.
Demeanor: playful, sweet and self-assured, performing for the lens. Her chin turns first and her eyes follow when she glances back over her shoulder; when her weight drops into a sway her eyelids lower for a beat and lift again as the hips rebound; a small smile opens at the release and settles back to calm confidence for the back-facing sways.
AUDIO: the dance track at about 129 BPM, no dialogue, no added effects. Avoid: any text, watermark, logo or UI elements, extra people, the outfit changing color or design, feet appearing in frame.

Shot (0-1s, Bar 1 beats 1-2):
Back three-quarter opening: she glances over her shoulder at the camera, hips already shifting, one hand hanging low behind her; the turn toward the front begins, hips leading. Avoid: starting front-facing, the turn starting with her shoulders instead of her hips.

Shot (1-2s, Bar 1 beats 3-4):
She comes to the front as one arm sweeps out to the side; both arms then rise and her hands land behind her head on beat 4 (about 1.6s), elbows wide. Avoid: hands reaching her head early or late off the beat, elbows drooping closed.

Shot (2-3s, Bar 2 beats 1-2):
Hands-behind-head hold: sway one drops her weight to one side, sway two rebounds to the other, hips crossing the center line each beat while her elbows stay wide and still. Avoid: the whole body freezing in the pose, sways shrinking into a wiggle.

Shot (3-4s, Bar 2 beats 3-4):
Sway three and sway four, same size as the first two, hair swinging a half-beat behind her hips; her smile opens slightly at the bar's end. Avoid: amplitude fading as the hold goes on, hair sticking to her back.

Shot (4-5s, Bar 3 beats 1-2):
Release one: her arms come down from behind her head, one dropping first with a small pump, then both open out to her sides, palms loose, as her torso starts rotating toward her side. Avoid: arms dropping straight down limply, the release happening before the bar line.
rows.步骤1中文翻译:
一段不剪辑的原地卡点舞：美丽的成年女性，很长的深色波浪发系小浅蓝丝带，穿灰色罗纹无袖高领连体衣（腰侧镂空、腹部小菱形镂空），浅蓝抽绳短裤带白边和白蝴蝶结，一条腿戴白色腿环。她在米白墙前跳舞，墙上有强烈斜向百叶窗光条，暖调高调日光，条纹影子投在她身旁墙上。音乐约129 BPM 4/4——每拍0.46秒，小节线约在0.2、2.0、3.9、5.7、7.6秒——每个重音动作都落在拍上：以背面四分之三姿势回头开场，转到正面时胯开始摆动，双手抬到脑后并保持，同时胯持续摆动，松开双臂张开，转身时向前伸手，最后以背面四分之三站姿缓慢沉重地摆胯、在身后小幅向下甩手，在摆动中途切断。
镜头：三脚架锁定全程不动；取景从头顶（距上沿约3%）到大腿中部，脚不入画；墙上光条和影子在画面中固定——所有角度变化只来自她自己的转身。
幅度锚点：摆胯大而沉——每个重音胯部移动超过肩线，长发甩过背部扫到手臂，条纹影子随她在墙上左右扫动。双手抱头保持时，每拍胯都必须越过中线；若摆动小、软或拘谨，则这条作废。
神态：俏皮、甜美、自信，对镜头表演。回头时下巴先转、眼神跟上；重心落入摆动时眼皮垂下一拍、胯回弹时抬起；松手时露出小笑容，背身摆动时回到平静自信。
音频：约129 BPM舞曲，无对白，无额外音效。避免：任何文字、水印、标志或UI、多余人物、服装变色或变款、脚入画。
分镜（0-1秒）：背面四分之三开场，回头看镜头，胯已在移动，一只手垂在身后；以胯带动开始转向正面。避免：一开始就正面、用肩带动转身。
（1-2秒）：转到正面，一只手臂向侧扫出；随后双臂抬起，第4拍（约1.6秒）双手落到脑后，手肘张开。避免：手早到或晚到偏离拍点、手肘下垂合拢。
（2-3秒）：双手抱头保持：第一下重心落向一侧，第二下回弹到另一侧，每拍胯越过中线，手肘保持张开不动。避免：全身定格、摆动缩成扭动。
（3-4秒）：第三、四下摆动与前两下同等大小，头发比胯慢半拍甩动；小节末微笑稍稍展开。避免：保持中幅度衰减、头发贴在背上。
（4-5秒）：第一次松开：双臂从脑后放下，一只先带小顿挫落下，然后双臂向两侧打开、掌心放松，躯干开始转向侧面。避免：手臂软软直落、在小节线前松开。

rows.题材标签: 真人风、舞蹈
rows.判断理由: 黑旗袍侧开衩高踢腿原地舞，无裸露
rows.步骤1提示词:
A single uncut in-place dance by a beautiful adult woman with her dark hair in a low bun and long dangling earrings, wearing a dark charcoal long-sleeved qipao with a mandarin collar, gold-and-white embroidered motifs at the chest and hem, and a side slit. She dances in a dim hall with rows of chairs behind her, hard window light falling in bright bars across the floor and over her silhouette. The track runs at about 110 BPM in 4/4 — one beat every 0.55 seconds, bar lines at roughly 0.2, 2.4, 4.6, 6.7, 8.9 and 11.1 seconds — and the choreography lands on the accents: she turns in from a side profile, points skyward twice, fires one high side kick, holds a long side-profile passage with flourishes of her fingers behind her back, crosses her arms in front, sweeps one arm overhead, opens both arms wide, thrusts both palms toward the camera twice, beckons with curled fingers, and settles into a slow sway before a final over-shoulder glance.
Camera: locked tripod, camera not moving for the whole clip; framing from the top of her head (about 4 percent from the top edge) to mid-shin; the chairs and light bars stay fixed — the only foreground event is her own palms thrusting toward the lens late in the clip.
Magnitude anchors: the side kick must fire to hip height or above with the qipao slit flying open; the behind-the-back finger flourishes must open fully wide where the window light catches them; the two palm thrusts must come close enough to the lens to loom large and soften in the foreground. If the kick stays low, the flourishes stay small, or the thrusts stop politely at arm's length, the take is wrong.
Demeanor: cool, composed, older-sister confidence with deep red lips. Her gaze stays on the lens even in profile, her head turned over her shoulder; the smile stays restrained through the front sections, opens fully only during the side-profile flourishes, and softens again as the sway slows at the end; her face does not change at all when the kick fires — the effortlessness is the point.
AUDIO: the dance track at about 110 BPM, no dialogue, no added effects. Avoid: any text, watermark, logo or UI elements, extra people, the qipao changing color or losing its embroidery, the window light bars moving.

Shot (0-1s, Bar 1 beats 1-2):
Side-profile entrance: she walks a quarter-turn in, skirt swinging, one arm trailing low, chin already turned toward the lens. Avoid: entering front-facing, the skirt hanging still.

Shot (1-2s, Bar 1 beats 3-4):
One arm sweeps across in a blur and she settles front-facing, hand landing on her hip, first hip sway on beat 4. Avoid: the sweep turning into a wave, settling before the beat.

Shot (2-3s, Bar 2 beats 1-2):
Point one: one index finger raised beside her face, the other palm open flat at her waist, a small bounce under the gesture. Avoid: both hands pointing, the raised finger curling.

Shot (3-4s, Bar 2 beats 3-4):
Point two melts into a turn to side profile; on the strong beat (about 3.4s) the high side kick fires — leg extending straight out of the slit to hip height — then snaps back down. Avoid: the kick arriving late or below hip height, her expression flinching with it.

Shot (4-5s, Bar 3 beats 1-2):
Side profile held, smiling over her shoulder: back-hand flourish one and flourish two behind her hip, fingers opening fully wide on each beat while her hips sway. Avoid: the flourishes shrinking to finger wiggles, her head turning away from the lens.

Shot (5-6s, Bar 3 beats 3-4):
Flourish three and flourish four at the same full size, gaze locked on the camera, the open smile at its widest. Avoid: amplitude decaying across the four flourishes, fingers closing into fists.

Shot (6-7s, Bar 4 beats 1-2):
She turns back to front as her arms open and cross in an X in front of her torso, then uncross with a small flourish. Avoid: the cross becoming a hug, the turn finishing late.
